exceptions.rationale: The approved Hickory 0.26.3 DNS resolver dependency reaches core-foundation 0.9.4 through system-configuration 0.7.0, while the approved rustls-native-certs 0.8.4 trust-store dependency reaches 0.10.1 through security-framework 3.7.0. Removing either version requires a reviewed change to the approved DNS or platform-trust dependency design.
exceptions.mitigation: Reassess the exact Apple dependency graph when Hickory or rustls-native-certs is updated; remove this exception when the approved graph converges. Revalidate system DNS and platform certificate loading on macOS before changing either pin. Expire this exception by 2026-12-31.
